title: MCP servers (MCP Manager)
description: workspace/mcp-servers.json: the MCP servers of the workspace, each global or for the projects it lists. Written by scripts/lib/mcp.ts. Values never hold credentials: they are ${VARIABLE} references read from the environment when a server starts. See docs/mcp-servers.md.

id.description: Stable (a rename keeps it) and unique in the whole workspace. Agents name it in their mcps contract.

command.description: stdio: a program name or absolute path, started without a shell.

url.description: http: the server's endpoint (http:// or https://).

access.description: execute: it changes things outside Moki; operation steps that use it wait for approval.

enabled.description: Off: kept in the list, given to no project.

projects.description: Where it applies: [] = every project of the workspace (global); otherwise only these project ids.
